arxiv-2103-15093.title: Representation Learning by Ranking across Multiple Tasks
arxiv-2103-15093.description: Abstract In recent years, representation learning has become the research focus of the machine learning community. Large-scale neural networks are a crucial step toward achieving general intelligence, with their success largely attributed to their ability to learn abstract representations of data. Several learning fields are actively discussing how to learn representations, yet there is a lack of a unified perspective.

arxiv-2310-11419.creator: Alexander Duncan, Wenbo Niu, Jinhyung Park
arxiv-2310-11419.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexander Duncan, Wenbo Niu, Jinhyung Park. The gonality conjecture, proved by Ein–Lazarsfeld, asserts that the gonality of a nonsingular projective curve of genus g g can be detected from its syzygies in the embedding given by a line bundle of sufficiently large degree. An effective result obtained by Rathmann says that any line bundle of degree at least 4 ​ g − 3 4g-3 would work in the gonality theorem.

arxiv-2406-19039.title: Constructing and Analyzing Different Density Graphs for Path Extrapolation in Wikipedia
arxiv-2406-19039.creator: Martha Sotiroudi, Anastasia-Sotiria Toufa, Constantine Kotropoulos
arxiv-2406-19039.description: Abstract Graph-based models have become pivotal in understanding and predicting navigational patterns within complex networks. Building on graph-based models, the paper advances path extrapolation methods to efficiently predict Wikipedia navigation paths. The Wikipedia Central Macedonia (WCM) dataset is sourced from Wikipedia, with a spotlight on the Central Macedonia region, Greece, to initiate path generation.

arxiv-2502-00906.title: Multi-Velocity Sharp-Interface Continuum Thermodynamics of Fluid Systems with Adsorption
arxiv-2502-00906.creator: Dieter Bothe In memoriam Wolfgang Dreyer
arxiv-2502-00906.description: Abstract We revisit the sharp-interface continuum thermodynamics of two-phase multicomponent fluid systems, accounting for partial mass and momentum balances both in the bulk phases and on the interface. This allows to describe the transfer of species between the bulk phases and the interface, i.e. ad- and desorption processes.

arxiv-2512-13453.title: Extending Weinberg’s EFT: effective scalar-tensor theories up to sixth order
arxiv-2512-13453.creator: Eugeny Babichev, Sukṛti Bansal, Maria Mylova, Antonio Padilla
arxiv-2512-13453.description: Abstract We present a systematic construction of the six-derivative effective scalar-tensor theories, extending the four-derivative framework previously developed by Steven Weinberg. The on-shell effective field theory comprises five parity-even and three parity-odd independent six-derivative scalar-tensor interactions, representing all inequivalent deformations consistent with general covariance.

pmc-12681450.creator: Jan Abel Olsen, Gang Chen, Admassu Lamu
pmc-12681450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveThe EQ-5D is increasingly being used in studies of health inequalities, providing further evidence of a social gradient in health; i.e. consistent positive associations between a socioeconomic indicator and health. However, the steepness in the social gradients in HRQoL differs depending on which of the two EQ-5D measures is used; whether based on respondents’ EQ-5D-5L descriptions or by their direct valuation in EQ-VAS.

pmc-13291865.title: Adhesive Restorative Procedures for Anterior Esthetic Rehabilitation: A Case Series
pmc-13291865.creator: Sachin Gupta, Shikha Jaiswal, Ankita Kumari, Gabbi Vimalpreet Kaur, Ridhiman Raman, Manasvi Sharma
pmc-13291865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The demand for esthetically driven dental treatment has increased substantially with advances in adhesive dentistry. This case series describes three anterior esthetic rehabilitation scenarios: (i) direct composite veneering for correction of anterior malalignment in vital teeth, (ii) combined in-office bleaching and direct composite veneering for fluorosis-associated discoloration in vital teeth, and (iii) conservative rehabilitation of structurally compromised endodontically treated teeth with sodium ascorbate neutralization, and anatomic fiber post fabrication with adhesive core reconstruction. All cases demonstrated satisfactory immediate esthetic and functional outcomes.

pmc-13363711.description: The food packaging sector widely relies on polymeric materials, and as sustainability concerns grow, commodity polymers need to be replaced with innovative and more sustainable materials. Thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) is a versatile elastomeric polymer characterized by flexibility, strength, chemical and abrasion resistance, and biocompatibility. However, it presents some limitations, notably in terms of functional properties (i.e., barrier properties).

pmc-13407891.title: Nationwide spread of multidrug resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae across US communities
pmc-13407891.creator: Jianping Jiang, Austin J Terlecky, Kevin J Rome, Elena Shashkina, Claudia Manca, Meghan W Starolis, Julia Larsen, Akinyosoye Olufunmi, Ariel A Aptekmann, Tara Lozy, Kelly K Yen, Mia J Bucich, Robert S Jones, Barun Mathema, Johann D D Pitout, Liang Chen, Barry N Kreiswirth
pmc-13407891.description: Traditionally viewed as a hospital pathogen, multidrug-resistant (MDR) Klebsiella pneumoniae is emerging in community settings, yet its population structure and spread are currently undefined. A nationwide genomic survey of 2006 ceftriaxone-nonsusceptible outpatient isolates from 42 US states reveals that the spread of resistance is primarily driven by the blaCTX-M-15 extended-spectrum-β-lactamase (ESBL) gene across diverse K. pneumoniae lineages.

pmc-13477416.title: Squamous Eccrine Ductal Carcinoma Treated With Adjuvant Radiation Therapy
pmc-13477416.creator: Ashley N Austin, Daniel A Jones, William McAfee
pmc-13477416.description: Squamous eccrine ductal carcinoma (SEDC) is a rare skin cancer with limited academia or documented definitive and/or adjuvant therapeutic options. Retrospective studies report aggressive course, high risk of local recurrence, and/or distant metastasis. Histopathology describes it to possess both squamous and ductal differentiation, causing diagnostic obscurity and misdiagnosis, begetting underdiagnosis, mottling the prognostic course.

We describe population characteristics and pharmacovirologic outcomes of PWH initiating FTR- or IBA-based regimens.

uslaw-usc-t22-s1645c.title: 22 U.S.C. § 1645c — Ownership of claims by nationals
uslaw-usc-t22-s1645c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s1645c.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 21 (Settlement Of International Claims); Subchapter VII (Claims Against Vietnam). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A claim may be favorably considered under section 1645b of this title only if the property right on which it is based was owned, wholly or partially, directly or indirectly, by a national of the United States.
